speaker: Doctor
text:
Those symptoms—persistent restlessness, fidgeting, and an inability to stay still—are classic signs of akathisia, a common side effect of the risperidone you've been taking. Before we conclude, can you confirm if these sensations feel like an inner urge to move or just general anxiety, and have you noticed any tremors in your hands?
